# Crown Watch Co. (Crown Watch Co. Ltd.)
> Premier destination for 100% authentic Casio, Seiko, Citizen timepieces, scientific calculators, smartwatches, and certified watch repair in Dhaka, Bangladesh since 1974.

## Core Information
- Website: https://crownwatch.bd
- Location: Crown Watch Tower, Gulshan 1, Dhaka 1212, Bangladesh
- Phone / Hotline: +8801700000000
- Currency: BDT (Bangladeshi Taka - ৳)
- Authenticity Guarantee: 100% Genuine product guarantee with official manufacturer warranty.
